content.value: Suppose, a number of jute processing industries are located at the periphery of Khulna city. Due (15) to some difficulties it has become unavoidable to shift the location from Khulna to Mongla. Identify some indicators having relevance with the situation and briefly narrate the process of developing a decision matrix.
